May I ask why a PCI adapter over a USB model? There's nothing wrong with USB adapters, so long as the chipset is supported by your kernel. There are plenty of choices out there, but my favorite brand is Alfa. The AWUS036NHA is a fantastic adapter based on an Atheros chipset. They work great with linux, you can grab one on ebay for around $25 shipped, and if you still aren't happy with the signal level you get you can use a different antenna.

I would suggest any card with atheros chipset.
Soon or later, you will (for educational purposes) want to try things like fern wifi cracker, pixiewps, reaver-wps...
